#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int calculate(int n) {
    int size = 2 * n + 1;
    if (size < 0) {
        throw "NegativeArraySizeException";
    }

    unordered_map<int, vector<int>> current;
    current[0] = {1, 0};

    for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; depth++) {
        unordered_map<int, vector<int>> next;

        for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
            next[opened] = {0, 0};
        }

        for (auto& entry : current) {
            int p = entry.first;
            int a = entry.second[0];
            int b = entry.second[1];

            if (p + 1 <= 2 * n) {
                vector<int>& target = next[p + 1];
                target[0] = (target[0] + b) % MOD;
                target[1] = (target[1] + a) % MOD;
            }
            if (p - 1 >= 0) {
                vector<int>& target = next[p - 1];
                target[0] = (target[0] + b) % MOD;
                target[1] = (target[1] + a) % MOD;
            }
        }

        for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
            vector<int>& target = next[opened];
            target[0] = (target[0] + 1) % MOD;
        }

        current = move(next);
    }

    return current[0][1];
}

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << calculate(n) << endl;
    return 0;
}
